headline: Committee hears plan to fix zoning in harbor triangle area

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The committee heard a proposal to rezone six harbor-area properties to B2 business, and the Planning Department said it supports it.
meeting.recap: Two presenters explained a proposed zoning change for six properties in the triangle area down by the harbor.[[0:04:37]] The presenter said some current zoning labels, like "open zone," do not exist in Maui County Code.[[0:07:09]] He said this makes some buildings non-conforming, which could cause problems if a natural disaster destroyed them.[[0:08:30]] The proposal would make the entire property B2 business zoning.[[0:10:21]] He said the owners are not proposing any new development.[[0:12:08]] Unlike a 2022 proposal for only the Maui Ocean Center properties, this one also includes the harbor shops.[[0:14:28]] One testifier said pathogens from the aquarium may be going improperly into injection wells.[[0:20:51]] He asked for an amendment requiring disclosure of what pathogens may be going into the ocean.[[0:22:34]] Public testimony was closed with no objections.[[0:24:10]] Maui Ocean Center and Harbor Shops agreed to split the cost half and half.[[0:27:09]] The presenter said an earlier rezoning effort ran into a lawsuit from another property owner.[[0:29:45]] The chair moved the item to decision making.[[0:33:56]]
decided: Public testimony on the zoning change was closed with no objections.
Members agreed to two rounds of three-minute questions each, with no objections.
meeting.next: The committee will move to decision making on the zoning change. The committee will continue to accept written testimony.
